meta.name: web-research-assistant
meta.description: AI-powered web research assistant that leverages BrowserAct API to supplement restricted web access by searching the internet for additional information. Designed for OpenClaw and Claude Code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 联网搜索补充信息，突破访问限制
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在受限环境中获取网络信息
copy.tagline_en: Search the web to supplement restricted access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to access web information in restricted environments

howto.what: 当直接访问网页受限时，自动搜索互联网并提取相关信息，生成包含标题、链接、摘要和研究报告的结构化输出。
howto.when: 当目标网站屏蔽AI访问、存在地理限制或付费墙，或需要补充当前信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索AI技术趋势的最新文章。
say.note: 使用默认搜索引擎和结果数。

say.text: 用Bing搜索竞争对手分析，取20条结果。

howto.what_en: When direct web access is restricted, automatically searches the internet and extracts relevant information, producing structured output with titles, URLs, snippets, and a research report.
howto.when_en: Triggered when target websites block AI access, have geographic restrictions or paywalls, or when supplemental current information is needed.

say_en.text: Search for the latest articles on AI technology trends.
say_en.note: Uses default engine and result count.

say_en.text: Search for competitor analysis on Bing with 20 results.
